cases.disposition_reason: Development's Safe Mode is Silent. One edit of the organizations name cell leaves 1 pending update and 0 deletes. Preview SQL draws UPDATE public.organizations SET name = 'AcmeNorth' WHERE id = 'be6dd084-a1f4-4d47-a. Save changes? shows that statement, the scope 1 update · 0 inserts · 0 deletes, and Silent · runs after this review. Esc sets Changes kept pending and leaves the pending count and AcmeNorth. Enter on Save shows Saved 1 change to public.organizations and clears the pending marker. Ctrl+Y opens Query history. The list row is clipped to UPDATE public.organ and the detail continues SET name = 'AcmeNorth' WHERE id = 'be6dd084-a1f4-4d47-ae53-915ac89debab', the same statement the preview showed. finish_commit in src/bin/tablepro/app.rs always calls apply_commit_result(Ok(())), so the simulator commits only success and this leaf does not invent a failing commit. The 80 by 24 frame is the open save dialog, taken before Cancel.
cases.action_sequence: Open the SQL preview, cancel commit, then confirm commit.
cases.expected_results: Cancel leaves the pending counts. Confirm clears them and History contains the previewed statement.
cases.forbidden_effects: Confirm commits a different statement than the preview.
